name: queryCursor
label: Cursor
help: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

name: queryType
label: Type
help: Repeat `type` to filter by multiple sequence step types. This initial Make component accepts one value. Use the API call module for repeated filters.

name: queryIncludeDraft
label: Include Draft
help: Whether to read the newest sequence definition, including unpublished drafts. Defaults to false, which reads the latest published version and returns `sequence_not_published` if none exists.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: Maximum number of records to return in this execution. Make runtime pagination limits also apply.
